Welcome to Dr Gabriele Benedetti's channel! 

If you like Chiropractic and Osteopathic ASMR Adjustments, this is the channel for you! 

We will upload videos every week showing various kinds of enjoyable adjustments! 

About Dr. Gabriele Benedetti:

- Osteopath DO with 3 medical degrees 
- 4 spoken languages 
- Specialist of Spinal Pathologies 
- Founder of the European Osteopathic Academy
- Course provider of Thrust Osteopathic Techniques
- TV speaker 
- Writer and scientific publisher 

Enjoy and don't forget to subscribe 🙂 thanks! ✌️
